# Welcome {.unnumbered .unlisted}


This is the online version of **Statistical Computing in the
Age of AI** by the rgtlab curriculum team. We have written it as
a graduate textbook in statistical computing for biostatistics
students.

We intend the book as a practical, code-first introduction to the
computing techniques that biostatisticians use daily. These
techniques include programming in R, version control, linear
algebra, simulation, statistical modeling, graphics, and
reproducible software. We also treat the emerging role of large
language models in each of these activities.

We have written the book in the tradition of the Posit book family
([*R for Data Science*](https://r4ds.hadley.nz),
[*Advanced R*](https://adv-r.hadley.nz),
[*R Packages*](https://r-pkgs.org)), and we use the same Quarto
toolchain. The book is written for a two-quarter course, one
quarter per half, and is printed in two volumes. It is one of
three books in a graduate sequence:

- [*Biostatistics Practicum*](https://rgtlab.org/practicum)
  covers the workflow infrastructure (Git, Docker, renv,
  Quarto, CDISC, SAS) that surrounds the methods.
- *Statistical Computing in the Age of AI* (this book). The
  first half covers the foundations and the core models; the
  [second half](intro-advanced.qmd) covers numerical
  stability, advanced optimization, EM, Monte Carlo,
  Bayesian computation, high-performance computing,
  high-dimensional methods, machine learning, software
  engineering, and interactive visualization.
- [*Applied Generative AI for Health Sciences Research*](https://applied-genai.rgtlab.org)
  treats generative AI as the orthogonal axis: capability
  classes, reasoning models, biomedical RAG, multimodal
  medical AI, agents, evaluation, regulation, deployment.

The reader is referred to the [Preface](preface.qmd) for the
motivation of the book and to the [Conventions](conventions.qmd)
page for the visual cues used throughout.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
The [Contents](contents.qmd) page lists every chapter on one page.
:::
